traits.name: Devil’s Sight
traits.text: Magical darkness doesn’t impede Cerberus' darkvision.

traits.name: Keen Hearing and Smell
traits.text:
Cerberus has advantage on Wisdom
(Perception) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

traits.name: Legendary Resistance (3/day)
traits.text:
If Cerberus fails a saving throw, it can
choose to succeed instead.

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text:
Cerberus has advantage on saving throws against
spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Multiple Heads
traits.text:
Cerberus has three heads. While it has more than one
head, Cerberus has advantage on saving throws against being blinded,
charmed, deafened, frightened, stunned, or knocked unconscious.
Whenever Cerberus takes 40 or more damage in a single turn, one of its
heads dies. If all its heads die, Cerberus dies.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: Cerberus makes three bite attacks and one claw attack.

actions.name: Bite
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 23
(3d10 + 7) piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) fire damage.

actions.name: Claw
actions.text:
Melee Weapon Attack: +14 to hit, reach 10ft., one target. Hit: 20
(3d8 + 7) slashing damage.

actions.name: Fire Breath (Recharge 5–6)
actions.text:
One of Cerberus’ heads releases a 60-foot
cone of flames. Each creature in the area must make a DC 18 Dexterity saving
throw, taking 42 (12d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage
on a successful saving throw. Each head has its own recharge counter.
